scope: read-only npm package bin declaration to shell/CMD/PowerShell launcher targets and observed normalized template families
limitations: Six normalized template SHA-256 pins are derived from currently installed H: shims and not an independently trusted npm publisher, signed release, or known-good immutable reference.
A matching bin field and shim text does not prove runtime command invocation semantics, loaded-process identity, trust in Node/script resolution or actual user execution.

The audit checks the 22 bin entries enumerated in the declared installed dependency closure and the 66 root .bin wrappers. It does not discover arbitrary global npm, browser-cache, OS package or other system launch targets.

All current source and lockfiles remain under broadly writable H: ancestors; repeated metadata matches and fingerprints do not qualify the security boundary or establish that original files are untampered.
A real restricted MTermDev account, protected code/state roots, native cross-account access and rollback are not provisioned/qualified and require specific future owner authorization.
